## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change makes the application do.

## Validation

List meaningful tests/manual checks and anything still unverified. Use synthetic data and mocked Groq responses for automated checks.

## Review checks

- [ ] No credentials, user PDFs, page text, or database files are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation/changelog entries are updated.
- [ ] Document filters, source mapping, and readiness/retry behavior remain correct.
- [ ] Any incompatible data/model change has an explicit migration approach.
